episodes.title: Caminen con los ojos bien abiertos
episodes.summary: Two Vatican officials investigate a miraculous healing attributed to a local priest. Upon their arrival, his mysterious disappearance puts a stop to the investigation.

episodes.title: El diablo apoyó la cola
episodes.summary: A coincidence casts doubt on Quintana. A witness reveals new information about Valentina's healing. The discovery of a body has similarities with Salinas' strange childhood.

episodes.title: Juventud de Cristo
episodes.summary: Local authorities investigate the recent murders. The Vatican puts pressure on the Envoys when they broaden the scope of their investigation, putting their stay in Mexico at risk.

episodes.title: No grites
episodes.summary: The Vatican tries to make The Envoys return while suffering the consequences of investigating Benavent, who reveals his true calling. Molina Reyes discovers a dark secret.

episodes.title: Descenso al infierno
episodes.summary: The Vatican forces the Envoys to take different paths. Salinas witnesses a particular ritual. Antequera fights to remain in the investigation when he receives a surprising message.

episodes.title: El viaje de Salinas
episodes.summary: Antequera discovers Quintana's painful past with Adriana and Esteban. Salinas puts Benavent to the test. Antequera and Emilia come up with a risky plan and Salinas discovers a new talent.

episodes.title: Mi nombre es Legión
episodes.summary: The Envoys help someone from becoming a new victim. Antequera and Salinas find answers inside the hospice while the main suspect of the murders runs away.

episodes.title: Líbranos del mal
episodes.summary: The investigation comes to an unexpected conclusion. The Envoys link Quintana to some healings inside the hospice.

episodes.title: El oráculo de Porto da Lua
episodes.summary: Galicia. Land of legends. The Envoys arrive at Porto da Lúa to investigate an alleged miracle. But they find a divided town where nobody wants them to succeed in their mission.

episodes.title: Las Llaves del reino
episodes.summary: After finding Joaquín Bustamante's body, Salinas has a vision and understands that this town is hiding secrets so dangerous that they don't only endanger their mission: They endanger their lives.

episodes.title: Los corderos del Señor
episodes.summary: Nuno is now the main suspect in Bustamante's murder. His life is in danger. At night, during the town's festivities, the Envoys are the only ones who can save him. If they arrive in time.

episodes.title: Requiescat In Pace
episodes.summary: With the mayor as the main suspect in Joaquin's murder, only the Envoys stand in the Brotherhood's path. But doubts and fears begin to affect them.

episodes.title: Libres de pecado
episodes.summary: Pilar is cleared of suspicion, the Brotherhood believes Nuno to be the culprit. First, they must stop Pilar from taking over the fishing industry. Alba is honest with her daughter. A bad idea.

episodes.title: El lago de fuego
episodes.summary: The public learns who Xiana's true father is. Bernal's rage threatens the town. Meanwhile, the Envoys understand that the cause of everything is in a past they ignore. Nuno is the key.

episodes.title: Hestia
episodes.summary: The night that the three Nuns lost their sight is the key. To find out what happened, those who are silent must speak: the three Sisters, the girl who saw the attack against Nuno and Cañola.

episodes.title: La luz en las tinieblas
episodes.summary: All cards are on the table. The Envoys try to escape the Brotherhood alive. Pilar puts the town's future at stake. And Bernal is about to lose everything he always fought for.
